findings.text: non-blocking: the coverage paragraph states 'measured on this tree at about 21 microseconds per entry to build and resolve a path against about 0.06 for the suffix check, over roughly 10,800 entries', but no log under the run directory records that measurement and the dispatch prompt and brief carry none of the figures; the entry count is independently checkable (git ls-tree -r 43e6f9eb6 docs gives 10,779 non-covered files), while the two timings a reader would use to judge the optimisation are unverifiable from the record.

non-blocking: the case is named test_a_non_covered_entry_is_rejected_before_its_path_is_built but its spy at :807-809 intercepts only Path.relative_to, so it proves the path is not resolved, not that it is not built: a mutation that leaves `path = Path(entry.path)` in place and moves the suffix check after it keeps every assertion green. The docstring states the narrower claim correctly ('not a resolved path'); the name overstates what the guard can see.
